title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
description:
arXiv:2610.02274v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis.
